---
ProcessingMeta
---
lastRunAt: ISO timestamp
duration: ms
membersProcessed: number
status: success | error

span.p:
members/index.json
---
MemberRegistry
---
members: Map of email to id
id: string (UUID)
email: string
displayName: string
role: admin | member
createdAt: ISO timestamp
lastSyncAt: ISO timestamp
syncCount: number

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
raw/{memberId}/{year}-{month}.json
---
RawMonthlyData
---
records: Map of day to DayRecord
DayRecord.entries: UsageEntry[]
UsageEntry: uuid, timestamp, model,
inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheRead,
cacheWrite, cost, sessionId, project

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
aggregated/{memberId}/{year}-{month}.json
---
MonthAggregation
---
memberId, month, year
totalCost, totalInputTokens,
totalOutputTokens, totalCacheRead
modelBreakdown: per-model stats
dailyBreakdown: per-day stats
projectBreakdown: per-project stats
sessionCount, entryCount

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
sync-logs/{year}-{month}/{memberId}.json
---
SyncLog
---
syncs: SyncRecord[]
SyncRecord: timestamp, hostname,
ip, userAgent, entriesReceived,
entriesNew, entriesDuplicate,
batchId, duration

prompts/{memberId}/{year}-{month}.json
---
PromptMonthlyData
---
prompts: PromptEntry[]
PromptEntry: uuid, timestamp,
sessionId, project, type,
content (user/assistant text)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
commands/{memberId}/queue.json

CommandQueue
---
commands: Command[]
Command: id, type, status,
createdAt, acknowledgedAt,
payload (revoke-token,
force-sync, update, etc.)

span.p:
views/dashboard.json
---
DashboardView
---
generatedAt, period
totalMembers, activeMembers
totalCost, totalTokens
modelDistribution: per-model %
dailyTrend: 30-day series
topMembers: ranked by cost
comparisonVsPrevMonth

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

views/members.json
---
MembersView
---
members: MemberSummary[]

currentMonth (cost, tokens, sessions),
prevMonth (cost, tokens, sessions),
lastSyncAt, trend (up/down/flat)

MemberYearlyView
---

months: 12x MonthDetail

sessionCount
